scope: Local-only GroupOrderSheet async handler completion, ScheduleSheet account locale formatting, and validateActiveGroup/syncActiveGroup ownership guards. UI layout preserved. No deployment, app/OTA publication, FAQ publication, production writes, or live financial calls.
changes: Verify current Supabase authenticated identity before group mutations, estimates and scoped reads.
Capture rendered account and active group/source ownership; discard stale account, external group and out-of-order load/estimate results.
Use synchronous refs to prevent duplicate create, join, invite, decline, preview, quote, remove, end and checkout requests.
Catch transport rejections and restore busy state; show app-owned error/retry copy for shared items, members, group status, friends and invitations.
Preserve a declined invitation until RPC confirmation, and preserve personal cart edits during shared item removal or checkout.
Validate create/join, friends invitation count, status, estimate, delivery quote, end-group and checkout receipt shapes before applying success.
Do not log raw group response errors.
Use the selected account locale, with fr-HT formatting for ht, in customer-zone schedule summaries.
